responsibility: This file owns front-end handling of Fortran array references and compile-time array shape/size reasoning. It parses subscripts, sections, and coarray references into gfc_array_ref structures, copies and normalizes array-reference metadata, computes dimension extents and total sizes from array specs, sections, shapes, and constructors, and provides utilities for recovering the effective array reference from an expression, all of which are later consumed by resolution, DATA handling, dependency analysis, and array lowering.
